posts.text: George Floyd’s murder shook the conscience of our nation and the world. The collective pain inspired a powerful movement for justice and reform. We must keep pushing until we truly have equal justice for all.

This Memorial Day, we honor the brave men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for our nation. We will never be able to repay the debt we owe them and their families, so we must instead carry the ideals they died for–Freedom, Liberty, and Justice–forward, every single day.

In moments of darkness, we need to let our light shine brightest.

Video

I made this video four years ago in the aftermath of my brother Cary’s stroke. I’m in awe of how far he has come in the years since. Cary’s strength, resilience, and spirit continue to inspire me every single day.

Grateful for the love and support of my brothers on this Brothers Day!

Video

The American people believe the system is rigged, we have to recognize that pain and lead a way out of it.

Video
You can’t make this up. Trump’s policy has enriched himself while working Americans are sicker and poorer since he took power.

I love Jersey.

Video

Trump’s billion dollar slush fund is one of the most brazen acts of corruption in modern history.

We cannot normalize this level of self-dealing and greed, and we must make every American aware how he is using OUR tax dollars for his own corrupt schemes. 

op: @katiecouric

Video

This Ebola outbreak is heartbreaking and infuriating. Thanks to Trump’s reckless leadership, we’re seeing the devastating consequences of gutting USAID and slashing global health programs — the very systems designed to keep us safe. 

Because of these thoughtless cuts, America is less prepared for public health emergencies like this outbreak.

op: @AaronParnas

Video

We can create so much joy for our communities just by expanding our definition of generosity and kindness.

Video

Sportsmanship. Grace. Kindness. On the field and in life may we all show it more.

Video

Senator Warnock lays it plain.

op: @MSNowNews

Video
Donald Trump won’t let a failed war derail his gravy train.

With a Supreme Court where some justices accept lavish gifts from billionaires with interests before the Court; a Congress awash in corporate PAC money and stock trades; and a President grifting off public office in plain sight, Americans have every reason to be outraged.

This cannot be about partisan politics. Democrats and Republicans alike must stand up and root out corruption wherever it exists.

Our government should serve the people, not the powerful. Democracy cannot thrive when public o

This is not leadership—it's looting.

Trump has made 3,600 stock trades just this year, climbing the billionaire's list on the backs of the American people.

Trading stocks should be illegal for all elected politicians, especially the president.

op: @ragingmoderatespod

Video

What a powerful act of love.

Video

Once again, the Trump administration has chosen to stand with powerful corporations over the health and safety of the American people.

Now they’re gutting regulations that protect us from forever-chemicals linked to cancer being dumped into our drinking water. Mega-corporations get to pollute, while our children, our families, and our communities pay the price.

op: @drjessicaknurick

Video

The proof is in the data.

Video

Donald Trump’s reckless wars, chaotic tariffs, and cruel cuts to essential services aren’t just squeezing families right now—they’re driving up the debt for generations to come.

Thanks @adammockler for laying it plain.

Video
